parallels.note: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;
but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept Yahweh’s command, and didn’t travel.
translations.bsb: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
translations.kjv: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed
translations.asv: And when the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of Jehovah, and journeyed not.
